title: ISMP S5 singleplayer and server modpack
description: ISMP S5 modpack for full singleplayer experience as well as server build.
body:
> If you are a member of ISMP S5 and need the mods to play the server you should probably go --> **[here](https://modrinth.com/modpack/ismp-s5-client-side-modpack)** <--

# ISMP S5 Singleplayer & Server Modpack

This is the full ISMP S5 modpack, built around a **fantasy and magic theme** centered on **[Enchancement](https://modrinth.com/mod/6hN1V6wJ)**'s overhauled enchantment system, with a focus on exploration through custom biomes, structures, mobs, weapon, etc. (you get the point).

# What this actually adds:
- New biomes across the overworld, nether, and end
- Overhauled and brand new structures and dungeons
- New weapon types including scythes, katanas, greatswords, battleaxes, and sea weapons (and a lot more)
- Expanded food and farming through Farmer's Delight and its addons
- A rehauled Nether and End (End update guys)
- New mobs from Friends & Foes and other mods
- New blocks, items, and game mechanics
- A **lot** of enchants

# Notes:
- If running on a server, adding server-side performance mods like Lithium is recommended
- If playing singleplayer, adding client-side performance mods like Sodium is recommended
- Configs may differ from the live ISMP S5 server
- While I try to keep this up to date the mods may not always be on the latest version (I try my best ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ ).
